evidence: Eater: the Ludlow Street bakery 'announced it was closing in April this year - the building was being sold' and reopened as Mel the Bakery in Hudson, NY (324 Warren Street).
Eater: 'MeMe's Diner ... is closing following a three-year run'; owners wrote 'we made the tough decision to close our doors for good,' last service November 22, 2020.
Misi's own site lists current service hours and live reservations at 329 Kent Ave, Brooklyn; no closure reports found.
Miss Ada's official site is live and accepting reservations at 184 DeKalb Ave; it also appears on the current MICHELIN Guide New York list.
Eater: the East Broadway location 'will permanently shutter at the end of September'; last day of service was September 30, 2020.
Eater headline: 'Kawi, Momofuku's Modern Korean Hudson Yards Gem, Permanently Closes' (March 2021).
Momofuku Noodle Bar's 171 First Avenue location has an active online ordering page; the East Village original remains in operation.
Eater: 'David Chang's Momofuku Ssam Bar Is Closing'; Crain's reports the Seaport location closed for good September 30, 2023.
Monte's Trattoria's official site is live with a current dinner menu, private-events page, and active OpenTable reservations at 97 MacDougal St.
Eater: 'Acclaimed Long Island City noodle destination Mu Ramen has closed'; the landlord leased 1209 Jackson Ave to Kuku Chicken from March 1, 2021.
MaLà Project's official site is live with a Midtown menu and online ordering/reservations across its locations, including 41 West 46th St.
Mắm is on Eater NY's current (2026) 38 Best Restaurants in New York City list; the restaurant also did a November 2025 pop-up per Wikipedia.
Nepali Bhanchha Ghar is ranked #11 on Eater NY's current 2026 38 Best Restaurants list and was named to the NYT 2026 Top 100 list.
New Wonjo's official site and its Toast online-ordering page for 23 W 32nd St are both active; no closure reports found.
The Flushing mall and its basement food court at 136-20 Roosevelt Ave remain in operation (Wikipedia article current through 2025-26, citing the mall's own site).
Noda is operating as a Michelin one-star eight-seat omakase counter, now at 37 W 20th St (it relocated from its former 6 W 28th St address), bookable on Tock.
Noz 17 has an active SevenRooms reservation page and live OpenTable listing at 458 W 17th St; no closure reports found.
Noz Market's official site lists current hours (Mon-Sun 12-9) and live reservations at 1374 Third Ave; it ranks #3 on Eater NY's 2026 38 Best list.
Eater: Nur 'has permanently closed. The popular restaurant abruptly ended its four-year run in Flatiron ... after dinner service on January 22.'
Thiru Kumar's NY Dosas cart at 50 Washington Square S remains listed as an active business with recent reviews; no closure reports found.
